deferral.blocker: Product/UX and native ownership have not decided whether Core retains a merchant-facing geolocation preview, explicitly pairs or replaces it with a real isolated shopper geolocation contract, or retires the client-only preview after equivalent behavior coverage. Core implements enabled-currency-gated GB-to-GBP selection and the shopper notice but has no merchant Preview action or simulation surface; actual shopper behavior changes the role, mutations, and cleanup and is not an automatic adapter. Native readiness is secondary.
deferral.affected_scope: Only the exact USD-default/GBP-enabled geolocation comprehension boundary: the frozen client creates a forced merchant preview whose visible notice explains that a UK visitor's prices change to Pound sterling, without proving real geolocation, converted prices, saved opt-in, shopper state, or provider behavior. If merchant preview is retained, it must use explicit deterministic GB identity, accessible preview semantics, clear GBP/Pound-sterling change and return-to-USD/dismissal paths, zero global/user/session/settings/provider mutation, and focus restoration. A shopper replacement or retirement requires an explicit legal disposition and separately approved oracle.
deferral.no_allowlisted_action_reason: The run cannot invent a new merchant preview UX or simulation API, silently replace a merchant contract with a shopper journey, decide whether converted prices are required, or retire the preview. It also cannot resolve the pending target/owner or bypass native readiness. Lower-layer GB-to-GBP mapping and shopper-notice tests prove capability pieces but cannot choose the product surface or close merchant comprehension. No provider writer or listener can resolve this decision.
deferral.unlock_decision: Product/UX and native ownership must choose retained merchant preview, explicit actual-shopper pairing/replacement, or legal retirement and approve the exact role, target, owner, simulation/geolocation mechanism, comprehension/accessibility semantics, converted-price boundary, and allowed side effects. Then satisfy native readiness; provide a deterministic USD-default/GBP-enabled fixture under ordered settings, catalog/rate, geolocation, and browser-identity ownership with complete raw/user/session snapshots and a pre-write restoration journal; implement the approved row-safe zero-retry oracle; restore every byte and run-owned browser artifact; and obtain fresh code, E2E-test, reliability, and accessibility reviews.
deferral.quarantine_status: No browser context, account, store, setting, user meta, shopper session, cookie, currency fixture, catalog/rate cache, geolocation fixture, lock, journal, provider object, listener, environment, retention record, or quarantine was created or changed for this row.
